name: Trickster's Bluff

automation.text: You are graced with a measure of Loki's silver tongue. You have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. If you fail such a check, you can choose to deal 1d4 Psychic damage to the creature you failed to deceive, and that creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

components.material: the petrified tongue of a serpent
